changelog:
Initial release of linkfox-skill-evaluator.

- Evaluates any skill for both safety and effectiveness, regardless of domain.
- Implements a comprehensive IPO workflow: static analysis, prompt/edge case testing, and dual safety-quality reporting.
- Classifies skill type to select proper evaluation criteria and quality questions.
- Uses a graded red-flag safety system combining static and behavioral analysis.
- Supports both absolute and comparative benchmarking, including prompt crafting and outcome assertions.
- Addresses incomplete inputs with fallback strategies and user prompts.
summary: Evaluate whether a skill is both safe to run and effective at its job. Use when the user wants to test, benchmark, grade, critique, audit, vet, or compare versions of a skill — phrases like "这个 skill 好不好"、"evaluate this skill"、"vet this skill"、"新版本比旧版本好吗"、"帮我测测这个 skill"、"这个 skill 安全吗"、"skill 有没有效果"、
